firmographic.name: Justworks
firmographic.company_description:
Justworks is a New York-based cloud HR and payroll platform, founded in 2012/2013, that operates primarily as a Professional Employer Organization (PEO) for small and mid-sized businesses in the United States. The company combines payroll processing, benefits administration, HR tools, tax compliance automation, time tracking, expense management, and global hiring capabilities into a single integrated SaaS product, holding IRS-certified PEO status and ESAC accreditation. Its underlying technology automates payroll across 4,000+ U.S. tax localities and supports contractor and Employer of Record hiring in 60+ countries, with direct local-entity ownership in each international market it serves rather than relying on third-party handoffs.

The product portfolio is organized into three core tiers — Payroll ($8/employee/month plus a $50 base), PEO Basic ($79/employee/month), and PEO Plus ($124/employee/month) — each progressively adding compliance support, HR consulting, medical/dental/vision administration, HSA/FSA accounts, and mental health and fertility benefits. A modular add-on stack extends the platform with Time Tracking ($8), International Contractors ($39), Dedicated HR Consulting ($30), US-Based Contractors ($8), an ICHRA offering via Thatch ($25), and a high-priced EOR module ($599/employee/month) for full-time international hires. An Expenses module launched in July 2023 supports receipt capture and approval workflows for PEO clients. The go-to-market blends self-serve online registration at shop.justworks.com with a sales-assisted motion for PEO and enterprise tiers, supported by phone sales (855-661-9022), content marketing, and review-site presence (4.6/5 ratings across G2, Capterra, GetApp, and others).

The business model is per-employee recurring subscription, with the company monetizing the volume of workers on its platform; in 2025, it processed $31 billion in payroll and $8.9 billion in taxes and generated more than 268,000 W-2s for PEO customers, with 1,000+ SMBs already managing global teams on the system. Justworks has raised approximately $160M+ cumulatively across multiple venture rounds (Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Thrive Capital, Redpoint, FirstMark, Union Square Ventures, Spark Capital, Latitude, and others), most recently a $16.8M round in November 2023. The company has expanded through acquisition (Justworks Hours in October 2020 for time tracking; Via.work in September 2023 for international EOR) and through ecosystem partnerships with benefits carriers (Aetna, Kaiser, MetLife, United Healthcare), wellness providers (Talkspace, One Medical, Kindbody, Peloton), and compliance resources (Mineral, Discern). Leadership includes founder Isaac Oates, President and CEO Michael Seckler, and senior executives across engineering, customer success, finance, legal, risk and insurance, and DEI functions.

expansion_highlight.description: Justworks supports international contractor payments in 60+ countries and operates Employer of Record in every market it serves (avoiding third-party handoffs), with the 2023 Via.work acquisition explicitly extending this international footprint.

Launch of the Expenses module in July 2023 and the ICHRA offering via Thatch partnership indicate ongoing buildout of the platform beyond core payroll, HR, and benefits into adjacent spend and benefits-administration categories.

Deep carrier and partner ecosystem including Aetna, Kaiser, MetLife, United Healthcare, NEXT Insurance, Talkspace, One Medical, Kindbody, Peloton, Health Advocate, Mineral, Discern, and Thatch indicates deliberate wraparound of high-value benefits adjacent to the core PEO relationship.
September 2024 elevation of David Feinberg to NAPEO Chair signals active pursuit of regulatory and industry-shaping influence over the PEO category.

The November 2023 capital raise of approximately $16.8M, on top of a cumulative ~$143M+ raised across prior rounds from Index, Bain Capital Ventures, Thrive Capital, Redpoint, FirstMark, Union Square Ventures, and others, provides continued capital for product and geographic expansion despite a step-down in round size versus the 2020 Series C.
Self-serve online registration (shop.justworks.com) combined with sales-assisted PEO conversion enables expansion upmarket while maintaining PLG-style acquisition economics for the Payroll tier.
